ceu: ✦ The sextile between Venus and Pluto

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, family and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Do not try to change the other person: try to understand them.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Start the day with the hardest task and the rest will feel light.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, money and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Laugh at yourself when something goes less well.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Make peace with a childhood memory.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Apologise for a careless word, if need be.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Put aside a small amount, just to build the habit.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.

The sextile between Venus and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Look after your image: a haircut, a new piece of clothing or simply standing up straight.
